1. Make sure your doctor has placed an MRI order in your medical record. 2. Book the scan through the Radiology front desk (Ground Floor, Block B), the patient portal, or the Radiology helpline. 3. Choose an available 30-minute slot, Monday-Friday between 09:00 and 13:00. 4. Complete the MRI safety screening questionnaire at least 24 hours before the appointment; the Insurance Desk will verify coverage if you have insurance. Appointments can be rescheduled or cancelled up to 24 hours before without charge.
The standard MRI appointment slot is 30 minutes.

Tell the Radiology team that you have a pacemaker and complete the MRI safety-screening questionnaire at least 24 hours before your appointment. The radiologist will review your information and decide if the scan can proceed safely. On the day of the scan arrive 30 minutes early and remove all metal objects, jewellery and cards with magnetic strips.
Patients should arrive 30 minutes before their scheduled MRI slot.
